summary: Apparatus chunks with verified tags: 35 Orphic Hymns Taylor Dissertation + 9 others carry 234 accepted concept tags and 579 live edges on editorial/prophylon front-matter

analysis.author: corpus-quality
analysis.content:
SWEPT 2026-08-20 across all 6068 chunk TOML bodies in corpus/ + data/guru.db. Found 44 apparatus chunks carrying verified concept tags:

ORPHIC HYMNS (Thomas Taylor edition) — 35 chunks:
greek_mystery.orphic-hymns.002 through 034 (33 chunks), plus .087 and .138
All have section='Front Matter' — these are Taylor's 'Dissertation on the Life and Theology of Orpheus' editorial commentary, not the actual hymns.
- 209 accepted (verified) concept tags across these chunks
- 507 live edges (EXPRESSES + PARALLELS) sourced from these chunks
- Orphic-hymns.002 alone: 4 accepted tags, section='Front Matter, p. 2 (part 1)', body starts 'PREFACE.'
- Orphic-hymns.007: 7 accepted tags, 8 EXPRESSES edges, 1 PARALLELS edge
- Orphic-hymns.017: 21 accepted tags, 23 EXPRESSES edges
- Orphic-hymns.034: 8 accepted tags, 21 EXPRESSES edges

OTHER TEXTS with apparatus+verified-tags:
- hermeticism.corpus-hermeticum-14.003: 9 accepted tags, 16 EXPRESSES edges (footnote block)
- egyptian.egyptian-heaven-and-hell.002: 2 accepted tags, 5 EXPRESSES edges (preface)
- western_esoteric.tarot-of-the-bohemians.001: 5 accepted tags, 5 EXPRESSES edges (preface)
- western_esoteric.book-of-ceremonial-magic.004: 4 accepted tags, 4 EXPRESSES edges (preface)
- western_esoteric.secret-teachings-of-all-ages.263: 2 accepted tags, 2 EXPRESSES edges (editorial)
- western_esoteric.secret-teachings-of-all-ages.382: 1 accepted tag, 1 EXPRESSES edge (footnote)
- western_esoteric.tertium-organum.002: 2 accepted tags, 2 EXPRESSES edges (preface)
- egyptian.egyptian-book-of-the-dead-index.002: 0 accepted, 1 pending (preface)
- egyptian.egyptian-book-of-the-dead-index.003: 0 accepted, 1 pending (preface)

OVERLAP: This is a sub-scope of ticket 50438e23 (which specifically called out orphic-hymns Taylor Dissertation but only as one of many apparatus-leak sources). This ticket captures the verified-tag contamination — the most dangerous aspect — which 50438e23's analysis did not quantify.

analysis.author: corpus-quality
analysis.content: flag_apparatus.py:349 — the has_surviving_tags() filter is the mechanism that lets apparatus chunks with accepted tags escape flagging. The script explicitly lists orphic-hymns.001-034 as apparatus candidates (line 112-113) but then filters them out because they carry surviving staged_tags rows (line 349: 'if has_surviving_tags(conn, chunk_id): continue'). The docstring (line 6-8) acknowledges this design: 'a reviewer sees a translator's preface or a footnote block and rejects every tag proposal on it.' But the filter means chunks where the reviewer did NOT reject all tags (i.e. accepted some) are never flagged as apparatus.

analysis.author: corpus-quality
analysis.content:
The orphic-hymns chunker config (chunking/greek_mystery/orphic-hymns.toml) uses strategy='page-as-chunk'. It labels front-matter pages as 'Front Matter, p. {n}' (line 7: section_label_format_no_number_match) but does NOT drop them. The page-as-chunk strategy treats every sacred-texts.com page as a chunk. The 36 front-matter pages (Taylor's 'Dissertation on the Life and Theology of Orpheus' + footnotes) become retrievable chunks.

Timeline: Chunked on 2026-04-28 (commit 3d3c4728, todo:10917af0) which re-chunked after adding section_label_format_no_number_match. Tags were accepted on 2026-05-14 and 2026-05-24 (Qwen3.5-27B model). The tag reviewer saw these chunks, read their bodies (which are genuine English prose about Orphism), and accepted concept tags — treating the editorial content as primary text.

Contrast: Corpus Hermeticum apparatus was fixed in commit d18a44cf (todo:50438e23) by adding BASELINE_PRE_STRIP patterns to scripts/chunk.py. The Orphic Hymns front-matter was NOT given the same treatment — it was only labeled differently, not stripped/dropped at chunk time.

analysis.author: corpus-quality
analysis.content:
The root cause is twofold:

(A) Chunking gap: The Orphic Hymns chunker config (chunking/greek_mystery/orphic-hymns.toml) uses page-as-chunk strategy with section_label_format_no_number_match='Front Matter, p. {n}' but no drop_chunk_patterns or pre_strip_patterns to remove the Taylor Dissertation front-matter. This is a per-source chunker gap, not a global one — the CH apparatus fix (d18a44cf) addressed sacred-texts.com translator headers but did not address the Orphic Hymns specifically. The front-matter is genuinely English prose that the tagger naturally tags as concept-bearing, so the reviewer accepted tags on it.

(B) Process gap: flag_apparatus.py's has_surviving_tags() filter (line 349) is designed to avoid dropping chunks that have human-verified tags, but this creates a catch-22: chunks with accepted tags escape apparatus flagging, so their accepted tags on apparatus content persist indefinitely. The filter's comment says 'any of these means a human or the model itself found real content here' — but a human reviewer reading Taylor's 'Dissertation on the Life and Theology of Orpheus' would reasonably find concept-bearing content (it discusses theurgy, divine knowledge, etc.) even though it is NOT primary text.

The remediation for (A) is a re-chunk with drop_chunk_patterns for the Orphic Hymns front-matter (whole-chunk drops, since these are pure apparatus) — but this is a Driver task (shifts chunk ids) with curation remap. The remediation for (B) is an escalation: flag_apparatus.py's filter should distinguish 'has surviving tags because a human vetted this as primary text' from 'has surviving tags because the tagger found concepts in apparatus that happens to look like real prose.' This needs a redesign — the current filter is a safety mechanism that backfires here.

analysis.author: corpus-quality
analysis.content:
Two distinct fixes needed:

(A) Pipeline (Driver/guru-dev): Re-chunk Orphic Hymns with front-matter drop. The chunking/greek_mystery/orphic-hymns.toml config needs drop_chunk_patterns that remove pages 2-6 (the Taylor Dissertation) and the footnote blocks at p.48/p.93. This is a whole-chunk drop that shifts chunk ids for ~35 chunks — a Driver task with curation remap (like CH-11 6→5 in d18a44cf). The 209 accepted tags on these chunks are at risk: they need body-matched remapping onto the correct hymn chunks, or re-tagging (the Dissertation discusses Orphic theurgy that may be validly tagged onto hymn chunks that express the same concepts).

(B) Process (corpus-quality/guru-review): flag_apparatus.py's has_surviving_tags() filter (line 349) creates a blind spot for apparatus chunks that have accepted tags. Escalation ticket needed to redesign the escape hatch — the current filter protects verified content from accidental apparatus-flagging but cannot distinguish 'verified because this is primary text' from 'verified because the tagger found concepts in prose that happens to be editorial.'
